T1: no stamp and no BUILD record -> stamped; the file holds HEAD's full sha and the Story's ids
T2: a valid stamp, HEAD moved, no BUILD record -> kept; file bytes unchanged
T3: mid-build approval — plan t1,t2,t3, record has t1 passed and was approved AFTER the stamp -> kept
T4: a record approved after the stamp whose one task has passed FALSE, or passed ABSENT -> kept
T4 (mixed): EVERY task must have passed — one passed and one failed, plan covered, approved after the stamp -> kept
T5: a record approved after the stamp but TASK-LESS -> kept
T6: a FINISHED plan-driven build (plan t1,t2; both passed; approved after the stamp) -> stamped at the new HEAD
T7: a FINISHED standalone build (no PLAN; one passed task; approved after the stamp) -> stamped
T8: a planned Story validated as a WHOLE (plan t1,t2; record holds a passed task whose id is the storyId) -> stamped
T8 (contrast): a passed task that is neither a plan task nor the storyId does NOT cover the plan -> kept
T9: a finished record approved BEFORE the stamp (or at the same instant, or with no approval, or an unparseable one) -> kept
T10: a PLAN json that is present but malformed makes an otherwise finished record NOT finished -> kept
T11: no stamp and an UNAPPROVED record with one task -> skipped-work-exists, no file
T12: no stamp and an APPROVED record covering one of three plan tasks -> skipped-work-exists, no file
T13: no stamp and an APPROVED record whose one task has passed false -> skipped-work-exists, no file
T13 (unreadable record): no stamp and a BUILD record that cannot be parsed -> skipped-work-exists
T14: no stamp and a FINISHED record -> stamped
T15: no stamp and a TASK-LESS record, approved or not -> stamped
T16: a repo with no commits -> not-written, no file
T16: a directory that is not a git repo -> not-written, without throwing
T16: the build-start directory cannot be created -> not-written, without throwing
T16: an empty epicHash or storyId -> not-written, nothing created
T17: an INVALID stamp with no recorded task is replaced by a fresh one; with an unfinished record it is left alone
T1/T2 together: a second call after the first stamp keeps it, even after HEAD moves on
stampBuildStart never writes or changes an artifact record
